title: apache/commons-lang#1750: ArrayUtils.reverse with Integer.MIN_VALUE as the end index
summary: A pull request that stops `ArrayUtils.reverse(array, start, end)` wrapping an end index of `Integer.MIN_VALUE` to `Integer.MAX_VALUE`. The bug's input was found for all six primitive overloads and shrunk to an empty array; the change was proved confined to that end index on arrays of up to four; the new version was proved to throw on no input.
verdictLabel: ✗ the bug's input found; ✓ change confined; ✓ new version never throws
notes: Commons Lang compiles with `javac` alone, and its primitive-array methods prove in seconds to minutes at `--max-array-length 4 --unwind 6`. Next in `ArrayUtils`: `indexOf`, `isSorted`, and `BooleanUtils`.
provenance: A real change to a published library, verified with the /verify-bytecode skill; the report is this folder's README.md.
